Main 1.158.0 (#243) made the project cap count BILLED spend only: tools/project-spend.mjs projectSummary now returns spendUsd (billed + list value, kept for compatibility), listUsd, billedUsd, billedUnknown, and projectCapDecision compares billed (+ unknown-cost reserve + exposure) to the cap. The board was not updated: it still draws the cap meter from familyUsd = spendUsd (the mixed total) and labels 'cap counts: billed + list value' (capBasis defaults to 'billed+list' because projectSummary has no capBasis). So a project working on flat-rate lanes looks near or over its cap when it is not. Fix the board side only. Do NOT touch tools/project-spend.mjs, tools/spend.mjs or tools/swarm.mjs.
1) tools/board-data.mjs: derive capBasis = summary.capBasis ?? (typeof summary.billedUsd === 'number' ? 'billed' : 'billed+list') everywhere it is set (projectOverview spend + overviewSpend, projectDetail detailSpend + spend). In projectOverview.spend add `capUsedUsd` = the number the cap compares: when capBasis is 'billed', summary.billedUsd (family billed total, already includes worktrees) ; else summary.spendUsd. Keep familyUsd as is for compatibility, and add `familyBilledUsd: summary.billedUsd ?? null`. The build-progress spend passed to buildProgress uses usd = capUsedUsd (fall back as today).
2) tools/watch-assets/board.js capCell: the meter and the 'X of Y' text use s.capUsedUsd when it is a number (else today's behavior); the breakdown line stays 'billed $A · list value $B (not billed)'; the label says 'cap counts: billed only' when s.capBasis === 'billed'. The 'shared by N trees (this one $Y)' line uses billed numbers when capBasis is billed (this tree's billed = cost.paidUsd i.e. s.billedUsd).
3) tools/watch-assets/run-kpis.js: the project forecast shows pj.billedUsd when pj.capBasis === 'billed' or when pj.billedUsd is a number (label '(cap counts billed only)'), else pj.spendUsd as today. Check tools/watch-cli.mjs line where snapshot.project = projectSummary(root): add capBasis the same way so the run page gets it.
4) tools/watch-assets/project.js Build progress spend line: uses progress.spend.usd (now billed) and the cap-basis label.
Tests: tests/board-page.test.mjs: with an injected summary { spendUsd: 9, listUsd: 9, billedUsd: 2, capUsd: 5 } projectOverview.spend has capBasis 'billed', capUsedUsd 2; with a legacy summary without billedUsd, capBasis 'billed+list' and capUsedUsd = spendUsd; projectDetail.spend.capBasis 'billed'. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-page.test.mjs tests/board-worktrees.test.mjs tests/build-progress.test.mjs tests/build-progress-roadmap.test.mjs tests/project-spend.test.mjs tests/watch-ui.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests use these files for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite.
